column8: Named scene (see --list-presets): applied above the saved config file and below environment and command line. Empty = none.
Color roles (background, body, accent, accent2). auto: drawn from this saver's family with the run seed. native: the saver's own colors. Any name from the shared role table.
Minutes between slow cross-fades to another palette of the same family (interpolated in Oklab: lightness moves steadily from one palette to the other, never through grey). 0 = keep one palette.
Pace of the slow director: seeded keyframes about every minute that change structure over minutes. 0 holds the opening structure.
Strength of focusing in the focal regions: sharper, brighter ribbons.
How strongly the sharp light gathers into a few regions; 0 = evenly spread.
Water depth: deeper softens the caustics and separates the near and far layers more.
Strength of the broad pools and slanted shafts of underwater light.
Size of the surface waves (and so of the caustic cells).
Draw every option you have not set (and the palette) from the run seed, inside ranges chosen to stay coherent. Off: defaults.
Detail tier. auto follows the GPU class of this machine (NCZ_SHADER_QUALITY still overrides it).
Fixes the run's randomness so it can be replayed exactly (same options). 0 = a new seed (1 to 999999) every run; the seed in use is logged.
